message.content:
Based on the images provided, here is the evaluation for each version:

**Image 1 (White on Black)**
*   **(1) Complete Wind Icon?** **No.** The icon is cropped at the top edge; only the bottom two curved lines are visible (the top line is cut off).
*   **(2) Wordmark Readable?** **Yes.** The word "Celsius" is fully visible and legible.
*   **(3) Quality Rating:** **6/10** – Good contrast and sharpness, but the cropping of the logo mark makes it incomplete.

**Image 2 (Navy Blue on Light Gray)**
*   **(1) Complete Wind Icon?** **No.** Same as above; the top line of the wind icon is cropped out of the frame.
*   **(2) Wordmark Readable?** **Yes.** Fully readable with good contrast.
*   **(3) Quality Rating:** **7/10** – Slightly better color balance than Image 1 for general use, but still suffers from the same cropping issue at the top.

**Image 3 (Black on Light Gray)**
*   **(1) Complete Wind Icon?** **No.** The icon remains incomplete/cropped at the top edge.
*   **(2) Wordmark Readable?** **Yes.** Fully readable.
*   **(3) Quality Rating:** **6/10** – Identical composition to Image 2 but with black text; functional but incomplete due to cropping.

**Summary:** None of the three versions show the **complete** Celsius wind icon (all three are missing the top curved line). All three display the wordmark "Celsius" fully and clearly.
